entities.summary: Jaylen Morris is an American former professional basketball player who played parts of three seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for Molloy College in NCAA Division II. He is currently an assistant coach for Daemen University, and a trainer at Darren Fenn's XGen Elite basketball academy in West Seneca.
